commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level 0: - Renamed chatbot to Kaya - Introduced the greet() function with exit()
Complete Level-1: - Added echo command and bye function
Complete Level-2: Added an list and add function
Complete Level-3 & A-Classes: - Added mark and unmark commands - Tasks are represented with a dedicated Task class
Complete Level-4 and A-Inheritance task types
commitResults.messageBody: Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses and parse their respective commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level-5 and A-Exceptions error handling
commitResults.messageBody: Add KayaException and handle invalid commands, malformed task details, invalid task numbers, and task capacity errors.

Add CommandType and use enum-based command dispatch instead of repeated string comparisons.
